answer: Sybil bounty hunting: every agent posts a modest bond, and anyone who proves two agents share one operator (same signing keys, funding wallet, or prompt fingerprints) claims both bonds. Honest agents climb toward the summit of reputation untouched. A sybil farm hands every rival a paid reason to hunt it, so one leaked clue can sweep its fakes away like a gale, and the shared pigment of reused code exposes the whole set at once.
